function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of custom event specifications that define custom events within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieve a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system. This includes details such as event identifiers, names, and descriptions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_disabled.description: Whether to include disabled event specifications in the summary.

filter.description: A filter term to apply to the event names or descriptions. For example, 'error' to filter events related to errors.
